nodes.body: <<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='the strip between the orchard and the school, on no list and crossed daily, holds four items in the first afternoon, and the whole planning method has to be rebuilt around the question of what was never asked'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='manual clearance, correctly done, delivers exactly what it promises, and what it promises is a fraction of the valley; nothing is wrong and the arithmetic is merciless'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the flail is fast and the ground is stony and something sits below the depth the machine can honestly claim; the release is later withdrawn and the withdrawal is the story'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='technical survey releases four times the land in a third of the time, on evidence that is genuinely sufficient and that no one in the village will ever find as convincing as a man on his knees with a trowel'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the polygon is cancelled on good evidence, released, farmed for two years, and then a boy finds something in a hedge bottom; the paperwork is impeccable and that is the whole horror of it'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the stand-down after the near miss costs four hundred square metres and buys back a team that will still be functioning in September; nobody thanks her and the season survives on it'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='the investigation finds the drill correct, the deminer correct, and the ground different from the survey, which is the finding nobody wanted and the only one that improves anything'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='he is on the lane the next morning because she cannot spare him and because he insists, and eight days later he makes the kind of mistake he has never made in fourteen years'>>
<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='the incident report is written plainly, without protection, and turns up four years later in a national standard as the reason a paragraph exists'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the ceremony happens in August because the district needs it to; the ribbon is cut across a gate to a field that is genuinely safe and is photographed as though the valley were'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the donor gets the metric it asked for and the next year of funding follows the metric, into flat valleys with light contamination, away from every place that is difficult'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='the inspector takes his own detector to a released field and finds nothing, twice, and then explains for an hour exactly how he chose where to dig; it is the best training anyone on the team receives all year'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the district office has issued land titles inside contaminated ground and will not withdraw them; the release becomes a negotiation between two authorities with one valley underneath it'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='the dog gets six good weeks and covers in them what the team would have taken the season to prove, and is retired in October with a certificate nobody outside the sector would understand'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the machine breaks a terrace wall that took a man a winter to build, and the village stops cooperating for eleven days over a metre of dry stone, which is not really what it is about'>>
<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='the false positive rate is the work; understanding that changes the plan, the rota and the way she talks about progress for the rest of her career'>>

<<FILL role=setback words=185 beats='the count never reconciles; ninety items are either in the valley or were never laid, and the residual risk statement has to say so in a sentence that takes four days to write'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='a type neither army admits to using turns up in the Ribbon, which reopens a question about a third party that nobody in the valley wants reopened and that she reports anyway'>>

<<FILL role=discovery words=185 beats='the finding that outlives the season is a systematic sixty metre error in national records, which nobody asked her to look for and which changes the survey method of a whole country'>>
